title: Sheet Protector Strategy for Western Blot to Reduce Antibody Consumption and Incubation Time
author: Kwon, Lee, et al.
materials: and lysed with RIPA buffer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, 89900). The protein concentration of the lysate was determined by BCA assay kit (23225). Western blot sample was made by adding PAGEST™ (GeneAll, 751-001), adjusting the final protein concentration to 1 mg/mL. The samples were serially diluted and stored in a deep freezer at −70 °C.

steps.title: Culture HeLa cells
steps.instruction: Grow HeLa cells (Korean Cell Line Bank, 10002) in high‑glucose DMEM (WELGENE, LM 001–05) supplemented with 10 % FBS (S001‑07) and 1 % antibiotic/antimycotic solution (LS 203‑01) under standard conditions.

steps.title: Treat cells for apoptosis experiment
steps.instruction: Add 1 µM staurosporine to the culture medium; include a negative control with 0.1 % DMSO. Harvest cells at 0, 2, 4, 6, and 8 h post‑treatment (and at 0 h for the DMSO control).

steps.title: Harvest and lyse cells
steps.instruction: Detach cells with trypsin buffer (LS 015‑08), collect the cell pellet, and lyse in RIPA buffer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, 89900).

steps.title: Determine protein concentration
steps.instruction: Measure lysate protein concentration using the BCA assay kit (23225).

steps.title: Prepare Western‑blot sample
steps.instruction: Add PAGEST™ (GeneAll, 751‑001) to each lysate and adjust the final protein concentration to 1 mg mL⁻¹. Serially dilute the samples as needed and store aliquots at –70 °C.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE and transfer
steps.instruction: Separate proteins by SDS‑PAGE and transfer them onto a nitrocellulose (NC) membrane using standard electrophoretic transfer conditions.

steps.title: Prepare antibody working solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the primary‑antibody stock 1:1,000 in TBST containing 5 % skim milk to make the working antibody solution.

steps.title: Apply antibody using SP strategy
steps.instruction: Place a sheet‑protector (SP) on the NC membrane and pipette 70 µL of the antibody working solution onto the membrane through the SP.

steps.title: Incubate antibody (choose condition)
steps.instruction:
Incubate the membrane with antibody according to one of the following SP conditions (no agitation):
- 15 min at room temperature (RT)
- 5 min, 15 min, or 120 min at RT
- 18 h at 4 °C (agitation optional; both agitated and non‑agitated groups give comparable results).

steps.title: Wash membrane (standard)
steps.instruction: After incubation, wash the membrane with TBST according to the usual Western‑blot washing protocol.

steps.title: Detect HRP signal
steps.instruction: Treat the membrane with WesternBright™ Quantum™ chemiluminescent substrate (Advansta, K‑12045‑D50) to generate HRP signal.

steps.title: Capture and analyze image
steps.instruction: Image the chemiluminescent membrane using ImageQuant™ LAS‑4000 mini (GE Healthcare) and analyze band intensity and molecular size with FIJI software.
